## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长 32%

**计算过程：**

- FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$39,306 百万**（来源：`press_release.txt` "Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32%"；`financial_statements.txt` Segment Results 表，Q4-26 = $39,306M）
- FY25 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$29,878 百万**（来源同上，Q4-25 = $29,878M）

同比增长率 = ($39,306 - $29,878) / $29,878 = $9,428 / $29,878 ≈ **31.56%**，四舍五入报告为 **32%**。

若按恒定汇率调整，增长率为 **31%**（来源：`press_release.txt` "increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"）。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（来自电话会原话）

**归因一：Azure 及其他云服务高速增长，需求超过供给**

Amy Hood 在 prepared remarks 中说：
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."

**归因二：on-premises server 业务基本持平，贡献稳定**

> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

**归因三（Q&A 中 Amy Hood 进一步阐释）：效率提升与产能交付加速**

当被问及 Azure 加速至 43% 的驱动因素时，Amy Hood 回应：
> "When you think about being able to deliver better, the first thing we focus on, and I tried to talk a little bit about it in my prepared remarks, is efficiency, being able to get more out of everything that we've got in the fleet. That applies to efficiency gains in the CPU fleet. It's going to be efficiency gains in the GPU fleet."
> "I would also say some of the process improvements we've made to make sure both CPUs and GPUs, just the lead time from how quickly we can get things to simplify it tremendously plugged in, was also improved over the past 90 days. And so, those improvements, again, are very quickly monetized when we're able to do that."
> "And at the scale that we're operating in terms of across the entire hyperscale fleet, making efficiency improvements that can be quickly monetized does result in acceleration in the quarter."

**归因四：GitHub Copilot 消费增长（来自新计费模式）**

Amy Hood 提及：
> "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

---

### 3. 归因中"已发生事实"与"前瞻性表述"的区分

| 归因 | 性质 | 判定依据 |
|------|------|---------|
| **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity** | ✅ **已发生事实** | "continues to exceed" 用现在进行时，描述当下持续的状态；且 Amy Hood 在 Q&A 中进一步用"the situation is obviously that demand exceeds available supply in a relatively extreme moment"强化了这是当前现实 |
| **Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet** | ✅ **已发生事实** | "was ahead of expectations" 是对已关闭季度的回溯性描述；"efficiency gains… made" 是过去时态 |
| **Process improvements… lead time… simplified… was also improved over the past 90 days** | ✅ **已发生事实** | "over the past 90 days" 明确指已经过去的时段；"was improved" 过去时 |
| **That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized** | ✅ **已发生事实** | "was quickly monetized" 已完成的动作，针对本季度已发生的事情 |
| **In on-premises server… Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition** | ✅ **已发生事实** | "were ahead of expectations" 和 "driven by renewals" 均为回溯性表述，描述已关闭季度 |
| **"we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"** (指 Azure 上半年增长将加速) | 🔮 **前瞻性表述** | "continue to expect" + "will accelerate" 明确指向未来；且这是 FY27 的展望部分 |
| **"we continue to expect… Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency"** (FY27 Q1 指引) | 🔮 **前瞻性表述** | "we expect" + 具体数字指引，明确是未来预期 |
| **"even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"** | 🔮 **前瞻性表述** | "continue to expect" + "will accelerate" — 面向未来的判断 |
| **GitHub Copilot 消费增长 (June business model change)** | ✅ **已发生事实** | "following the June business model change" 指的是已发生的计费模式变更带来的结果；"benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption" 描述已实现的消费数据 |

**判定方法总结**：
- **已发生事实**：使用过去时态（was/were/did）、回溯性副词（already, in-quarter, over the past 90 days）、对已关闭季度的描述（"ahead of expectations"）；或在 Q&A 中描述"the situation is…"当前状态
- **前瞻性表述**：使用 "we expect / we continue to expect / will / anticipate" 等未来导向动词；或在 Outlook 部分给出具体数字指引（"approximately 45%"、"33% to 34%"）；或使用 "continue to expect… to accelerate" 等明确指向未来的措辞
